test(e2e): align chat-layout spec with cycle-00 product intent (51/51)

- Context/commit menu: divergence + change counts asserted absent;
  commit actions enabled without divergence gating.
- Project Link onboarding: V2 identity-only payload asserted (no branch,
  pipeline, or MCP fields); no pipeline discovery.
- Canonical Timeline rewrites: image/tool/approval/final tests migrated
  from legacy ui.chunk SSE to workflowChatSse turn events; legacy event
  duplication asserted absent.
- Review Queue surfaces replaced by the derived Changes flows.
- No true regressions found; assertions match shipped behavior.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
